python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; Path('programs/task-87814d41.py').write_text('def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    # The object consists of two parallel diagonal rays; infer each ray's color
    # from bottom seed pairs, then extend both rays to their board edges.
    slopes = (1,-1)
    groups = {}
    for r,c in pts:
        col=grid[r][c]
        for dc in slopes:
            groups.setdefault((col,dc),[]).append((r,c))
    for (col,dc), cells in groups.items():
        cellset=set(cells)
        starts=[p for p in cells if (p[0]+1,p[1]+dc) in cellset]
        if not starts: continue
        start=max(starts, key=lambda p:p[0])
        r,c=start
        while r>=0 and 0<=c<w:
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=col
            r-=1; c-=dc
    return out
')" && python3 -c "import importlib.util; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('t','programs/task-87814d41.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m);d=[[2]*26 for _ in range(7)];d[4][16]=5;d[4][19]=9;d[5][17:19]=[5,9];d[6][17:19]=[8,5];o=m.transform(d);print([(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(o) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=2])"
